hero.lead: Developing sublimated sportswear, custom apparel and industrial embroidery files (DST/PES) calibrated for fabric elasticity and machine efficiency.

about.title: KINGDOM by Ramses Martínez
about.desc: Immersed in the textile trade from an early age and working professionally since age 18, KINGDOM is the personal brand of Ramses Martínez, uniting industrial embroidery digitizing, athletic vector illustration, and custom made-to-order production.

timeline.title: Family Textile Roots
timeline.desc: Immersed from an early age in garment assembly, fabric cutting and industrial embroidery, understanding materials hands-on.

timeline.title: Freelance Embroidery Digitizer
timeline.desc: Delivered on-demand Wilcom stitch programming for garment manufacturers in Lima, optimizing DST/PES matrices for production efficiency.

timeline.title: Birth of Kingdom
timeline.desc: Independent workshop in Barquisimeto: high-volume embroidery digitizing, performance sublimation art and made-to-order apparel.

services.title: Digital & Physical Solutions
services.desc: Digital services are available worldwide; physical garments are made to order with delivery lead times based on project scope.

items.title: DST / PES Embroidery Digitizing
items.body: Technical punching with fabric pull-compensation, calibrated density and clean sequences designed to minimize thread breaks in production.

items.title: Full Print Sports Sublimation
items.body: Scaled pattern templates and color profile calibration for performance fabrics (Dry-Fit, microfibers and technical polyester).

items.title: Embroidered Corporate Uniforms
items.body: Corporate shirts ($25 with 2 logos · $35 with 5 logos) and institutional jackets embroidered in high definition.

items.title: DTF Shirts & Graphic Design
items.body: Textile DTF printing on 20/1 cotton and blends, logo vectorization, color separation, and business card design.
